_source: captured live 2026-07-30, lightningfaucet.com/api/l402/llm_prompt (post-redirect; catalog says llm-prompt); credential truncated, invoice real; body token/macaroon truncated too (they duplicate the header credential)

auth_instructions.step_1: Save the token from this response
auth_instructions.step_2: Pay the invoice using your Lightning wallet
auth_instructions.step_3: Get the preimage (payment proof) from your wallet
auth_instructions.step_4: Retry this request with header: Authorization: L402 <token>:<preimage>
auth_instructions.note: The token is the base64 string from this response. The preimage is a 64-character hex string returned by your wallet after payment.
